messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **federal statutory holidays** in Canada for 2023 that typically create long‑weekend opportunities (i.e., holidays falling on a weekday).  
*(Note: Some provinces/territories observe extra holidays that aren’t listed here.)*

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Potential |
|---------|-------------|-------------|------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | Weekend only – no extra day off unless you take a vacation day. |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Same as above. |
| Islander Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Same as above. |
| St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Mar 17 (Friday) | Friday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Easter Monday (Federal employees only) | Apr 10 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend for federal workers. |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | Weekend only – no extra day off unless you take a vacation day. |
| Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Aug 7 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Remembrance Day (observed federally) | Nov 11 (Thursday) | Thursday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend if you take a vacation day. |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – creates a 4‑day weekend. |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | Yes – creates a 5‑day weekend if you take a vacation day. |

### How to Use This List
- **Plan around the Mondays**: Most of the long weekends start on a Monday, giving you a natural break from work.
- **Check your province**: If you’re in British Columbia, for example, you’ll also have *Family Day* on Feb 20 and *Civic Holiday* on Aug 7. In Quebec, you’ll have *Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day* on Jun 24 (Wednesday), which could be used strategically for a mid‑week break.
- **Combine with vacation days**: For holidays that fall on a Wednesday or Thursday (e.g., Remembrance Day, Boxing Day), consider taking a day or two off to stretch the weekend.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown for a specific province or territory!
